title: Open Orange Everyday & Savings Booster, Dep $1000 & Make 5 Transactions Per Month over 3 Months, Get up to $400 (New Cust) @ ING
body:
Deal: Open Orange Everyday & Savings Booster, Dep $1000 & Make 5 Transactions Per Month over 3 Months, Get up to $400 (New Cust) @ ING

[Dashedlh007] Waiting for the last one to be paid, hopefully soon!
[nicholasv] Really good bonus, but surely less than 0.01% of the ozbargain community would be eligible
[Pacify] You are right, you'd think wouldn't be many OZbs that don't have an ING account by this point lol
[nicholasv] $148.60 to change your name in Victoria. Net profit of $251.40?? 😂
[kaitongvan] What's the cost to change all documents?
[coldazure] why such a low proportion? have i been missing out on an ongoing and epic ING product that I don't know about but everybody else does?
[nicholasv] Can't have had an account in the past ~7.3 years.
During that time, ing's offering was pretty decent (and still is) - reliably one of the highest interest rates and previously offered a rebate for international atm fees and spending. So it was generally the ozbargain bank of choice.
Also, don't underestimate how little of a sign up bonus it takes to get an ozbargainer to sign up to something 😂
[coldazure] the last time i held an ING account they still had cashback on spend, which was the only thing of appeal to someone like me.
never bothered with the rebate on international ATM fees and don't see that as a thing a majority of people would bother with or be in a position to really take advantage of.
haven't had to bother too much with savings accounts until this year since i've always just chucked all my money into offsets, which i assume to be the actual demographic the majority of ozb falls into.
there's probably a good chunk of ING account holders over the past 7 years but I wouldn't have thought 99.99% if it was only because of those benefits.
[NobalaKoba] @coldazure: The international fee rebate was automatic, didn't need to 'bother with it'.
[coldazure] @NobalaKoba: i meant that personally, i've never used a single ATM when i'm travelling. i use credit 90% of the time, and 10% of the time it's cash that i converted in a single lump sum at whatever place has the best exchange rates for obvious reason.
i'm sure it's useful for those that travel a lot and uses ATMs internationally. but again my point is I wouldn't say that applies to 99.99% of the people here, but i guess i could be wrong.
[Cluster] You would be surprised. I have friends who are short on cash but scoffed at my $100 referral code. 'Only $100? I then have to put up with a useless account'.
$400 might get them interested. Maybe.
[nicholasv] I wouldn't call your friends ozbargainers then
[udika] Would it be possible for my misso and I to open a separate account to maximise profit? Has anyone tried?
[Disabled-User] No I haven't tried opening an account with your missus. Are you ok for me to try?
[spaceflight] Has anyone tried?
Opening an account as an individual?
Lots of people have
[Pacify] ING sure does love giving away money to try and convince people to open accounts.
I can't understand how its worth it
[JoeyJoeJoe] 7 year exclusion period. ING really don’t like Churners. Boooo
[timhn] Good promo and easier to achieve than some low rate/fee credit card going around.
[CodeXD] This offer is only available to customers who have not held an ING account, excluding Living Super and ING Insurance products (Home & Contents, Car, Motorcycle, Travel and Pet), at any point since 1 July 2019 (even if that account is now closed).
oof that's a rough condition
[No ONE] This offer is only available to customers who have not held an ING account…at any point since 1 July 2019
How do I check the last time I closed my account and to ensure I'm eligible?
[shivaussie] Same question, how to check?
What if I open the account In wife's name?
[princeofpoverty] Reward is great but why not put the same amount in improving UI/UX of the app, I mean they made it worse with their new app and disabling the previous one, everyone banking with ING is millenial or by far like 40-50 year olds and even people that old understand difference between good and bad UI/UX
[yeetus] As a 'gen zer' i don't even want to start about the new apps UI, its atrocious compared to the old app. Don't even know why they did all that, fixed something that wasn't even broken.
[Joe3] Totally agree
Old app still works for me TG
[yeetus] Yeah same lol using the old app until they pry it out of my dead cold hands
[princeofpoverty] Exactly right? The new app is so terrible compared to the old one
[Pacify] $400 vs some very, very minor annoyance with app design….
Strange neg.
[princeofpoverty] It's a great app if you dont compare it with Ubank or others, in it's own bubble ING app is great but for me personally if I'm interacting with the banking app once or twice a day and it's more pleasant to use I'd go with that for the long term rather than $400
I mean I myself was a ING customer before they rolled out the new app and made the previous app redundant and comparing to their previous app itself the newer app is so much worse even if we're not comparing it to the competitors, for once round-ups feature never seemed to work for me in the ING app and work fluently with Ubank app and the budget tracking inbuilt with Ubank is excellent in tracking transactions as well
[armageddeus] Can family member with same address (eg. 18yr old) open this ?
[WhatsOnDiscount] With the referral, would that mean up to $500?
[Astrom] I would assume that would be a "promotional offer", but you could call them tomorrow to check?
""" This offer cannot be used with another promotional offer unless ING expressly says otherwise."""
[Purpleshres] I have just opened with allowance to use just one promo code.
[ffagz] what exactly is external source for fund transfer. Is there an FAQ?
[timhn] You deposit money from a bank that not from ING - eg NAB, ANZ etc or cash deposit or pay from your salary
[Its4me] I received a transfer from an ING account in another name (spouse) and had to hassle customer service multiple times to get the bonus, eventually. Would be much less hassle to send money from another bank.
[Astrom] Wait there is no condition saying you need to keep the $1000 inside the account either?
So someone could put $1000 in, take it out after then put that same $1000 in the next month?
[timhn] Yep, and don't need to be in a single transaction - ie can do $200x5 times.
[katotefu] Is there a way to check you've completed successfully?
[tianyujojo] Yes, you can check in ING app if you have met 'Deposit $1000+ from an external source'.
[vaketor] Can we just transfer $1000 form our commbank accounts? I mean if we can would be easy task
[Blokeinhisundies] Why wouldn't you be able to? Nothing special about commbank accounts.
[katotefu] Easiest way to fulfill transaction requirement? Beem transfers work for ING?
[katotefu] I'm referring to the "Make 5+ settled (not pending) card purchases* using your Orange Everyday debit card."
[Pacify] I usually just buy 5x$1 amazon gift cards
[T-man] Why not 5 cents transactions at Coleworths?
[AsukaST] why not 1c transactions?
and pay the rest with discounted gift cards.
[amsaini15] Is their a age requirement? Has to be 18?
[fraxinus] I did too early this month, first time with ING so would’ve been eligible for this offer.
As a wise man once said, “Missed it by that much!”
[mayo88] Thanks just opened a new account. Waiting for my account to be reviewed.
[AsukaST] I wish they can extend the offer until end of Nov.
I've a large sum of term deposit maturing in Nov so if I open a Savings Booster in Oct, it will only be a bonus much less than $400.
Because I will lose 20 days of 0.6% welcome bonus rate for my large sum of $. :(
[katotefu] You don't have any other money? As far as I am aware you can just transfer money in and out until you reach the $1000 total deposited for the relevant month.
[AsukaST] It's not about the $1000. That's the easy part.
It's about the SB.
I am planning to open a SB and transfer large sum of $ when my term deposit with another bank matures in late Nov.
This promotion requires me to open a SB by 31/Oct.
That will cause me to lose the bonus 0.6% welcome bonus rate of SB for that large sum of $ for the period of 1/Nov to late Nov.
The 0.6% welcome bonus rate only last for first 4 months, from the 1st day of opening SB acc.
Also this offer cannot be stack with $100 referral bonus.
[Melbourne Mama] Thanks OP ! Opened the account. Thought of doing this for $200 bonus few years back, but could not do.
[Mokr] Why are banks fiving people 400 dollars to open debit accounts but credit cards
[financialminimalism] someone's trying to reach their end of year target.
and they are loaded, so they are just using some of their profit.
[Pacify] Not "banks".
ING.
There's no other bank that gives anywhere near close the amount ING gives out just for using their normal banking functions.
[Nillionaire] uBank's $100 for referer and referee last year was fun
[Its4me] They report to the shareholders how many account holders they have acquired.
Analysts price a business on how many account holders (or users), amongst other things.
More account holders -> share price goes up.
[Aerith-Waifu] i had this a long time ago (6 years ago by memory) but its closed, can i still get the bonus?
[legelas] This offer is only available to customers who have not held an ING account, excluding Living Super and ING Insurance products (Home & Contents, Car, Motorcycle, Travel and Pet), at any point since 1 July 2019 (even if that account is now closed).
[davidl222222] if only they give out $200 to new account + $200 to referrer…
then there will be a lot more people pushing this out! :D
[shoppinginsyd] Anyone knows how to find out when old ING account closed? I got one opened in 2014 and didn't use it too much. Not sure when was it closed.
[link90] Just call them, I did so like 3 times to check if I created the account properly in the last $100 promotion. Every time, the customer service rep checked my eligibility including when I last held an account.
[cristobaljamesy] Does this deal work if you've never opened a savings but have always had the transaction?
[Craftboy77] anyway to check progress? or if it activated properly
[blues99] How can I check when I last had an ING account?
